question.text: Investors can exit an AIF before maturity through:

answer.text: Simple redemption like a mutual fund
Secondary market sale of units or exit due to material PPM changes, with limited liquidity
Email request to the fund manager

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.6 of the workbook covers the exit process triggered by material PPM changes, while Section 10.7 describes secondaries as the sale of existing unit or partnership interests; secondary transactions are complex, close-ended, illiquid, and negotiated. The Trap: AIFs do not offer mutual-fund-style on-demand redemption, and informal email requests or SEBI complaints are not exit routes. Note: Based on workbook pages 201 and 215-217 (Sections 10.6 and 10.7).
